entities.name: Ninety-Five Theses
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Martin Luther's 1517 document challenging the Catholic practice of selling indulgences. Nailed to the door of Wittenberg Castle Church, the Ninety-Five Theses ignited the Protestant Reformation and permanently split Western Christianity.
